text:
violet: Quick heads-up 1: noticed an audit-log gap for KMS grant events between 2026-03-10 02:00Z and 2026-03-10 04:30Z. Several grants show up in kms_grants but no matching audit_events. Could be webhook failures or a retention quirk.

pavan: thanks for flagging. how many grants are we talking about? and any obvious principals?

violet: about 29 grants, mostly principals starting with svc-ml- and svc-analytics. sample row: `grant_id=G-9b3c, principal=svc-ml-trainer, created_at=2026-03-10T02:17:12Z, requestor=NULL`

rachel: oh that window overlaps the infra deploy where we rolled the audit webhook. we saw a short spike of 502s in the deploy logs. @lee did we lose events?

lee: deploy did introduce a transient lambda timeout. I patched the retry and backpressure yesterday. logs show a burst of `WebhookError 502` from 02:05-02:20Z, then retries queued and eventually delivered for most events. but looks like some grant events never got to the queue.

pavan: if requestor is NULL we shouldn't auto-demote those service principals. they might be legitimate. can we backfill from s3 raw events or nginx logs?

lee: good call. we have raw webhook payloads in s3 with prefix `audit-webhooks/2026/03/10/`. I'll run a quick grep and try to match grant_id.

infra-bot: Reminder: scheduled entitlement prune `monthly-admin-pass` set for 2026-04-09T04:00Z. Default grace_days=7.

violet: please pause the prune for analytics+ml principals until backfill completes. we don't want accidental demotions.

access-bot: Action request received: to pause `monthly-admin-pass` for principals matching `svc-ml-%` and `svc-analytics-%` until 2026-04-12. To change pause window open PR infra/tools/admin-prune#pause-request.

rachel: i'll take the backfill. plan: (1) search s3 webhooks for matching grant_ids, (2) if missing, correlate with nginx access logs for request bodies, (3) flag remaining unmatched rows as `needs_manual_review`. will post progress by EOD.

lee: if backfill can't find requestor, we should mark `grant_origin=unknown` and set `demotion_exempt=true` for this pass. we'll record a follow-up ticket to re-evaluate.

pavan: +1. also add `audit_gap_incident` tag with the deploy id so we can exclude these during automated runs for 30 days.

violet: suggested query to find suspects:
```
SELECT g.grant_id, g.principal, g.created_at, g.requestor
FROM kms_grants g
LEFT JOIN audit_events e ON e.grant_id = g.grant_id
WHERE e.grant_id IS NULL
  AND g.created_at BETWEEN '2026-03-10T02:00:00Z' AND '2026-03-10T04:30:00Z';
```

rachel: running now (dry-run). so far matched 18/29 in s3. 11 remain unmatched. posting details in the doc.

lee: i'll open infra#2901 to add `demotion_exempt` and `audit_gap_incident` fields and a one-time migration to tag unmatched grants.

pavan: after backfill let's produce a tiny report: matched_count, unmatched_count, principals impacted, and whether any have owner_email NULL. i'll own that.

violet: thanks. TL;DR: pause prune for affected principals, backfill audit payloads, tag unmatched as exempt + incident, update infra to persist exemption, then resume after triage.

access-bot: Pause acknowledged. `monthly-admin-pass` paused for label `audit-gap-2026-03-10` until 2026-04-12T00:00Z. To resume earlier comment `resume monthly-admin-pass`.

rachel: done with initial backfill notes. posting the list and next steps in the ticket. will ping when we can safely unpause.

lee: thanks everyone. follow-ups: lee -> infra#2901 schema + migration, rachel -> s3/nginx backfill, pavan -> post-run report, violet -> confirm resume.

pavan: ack.
